name: link_prediction
author: 37c243f2
description: Ranks candidate missing links in directed or undirected graphs using common-neighbor, Jaccard, or Adamic-Adar similarity. Use it to suggest likely future connections between nodes. Returns endpoint node references, scores rounded to six decimals, and the selected similarity method.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to analyse.

method.description: Similarity measure used to score candidate links.

top_k.description: Maximum number of candidate links to return (1 to 100). Long lists may be shortened to keep the response under 8 KB.
